findings.description: V70 direct inspection of the current five views and six pose renders, corroborated by Astra, still shows repetitive angular accordion folds and facets along the side and rear panels; additional longitudinal sampling softened only part of the center front and did not produce a coherent controlled sewn drape.

V70 sit and crouch renders still expose most anterior/top thigh areas; front panels pull laterally and bunch sharply around the hip and knee rather than maintaining continuous lap coverage. Astra independently confirmed this blocker.
The rear waist adjustment tab remains too small/indistinct in the full-body rear view; no close-up evidence demonstrates its function.

The current source-bound V70 UV/mesh showcase is regenerated from the V70 Blender source (source hash 4c9ec8aca912874ed8060c7255b852c2c43a416050406f76f317d2a22c6d7656). UV status remains PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED: one of seven objects is source-authored, two active UVMap layers are provenance-unverified, and four objects are unmapped. No replacement or automatic UVs were generated.

nextAction: Run separately bounded skirt-drape/fold-profile and authored continuous front-lap coverage trials for the anterior and superior envelopes of both thighs in sit and crouch. Rebuild, directly review all five views and six poses, and validate the rear adjustment tab at a readable scale. Keep UV status PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED until source-authored mappings and their provenance are actually verified. Preserve the current residual/orientation bounds and all fit, runtime, package and release gates; retain REJECT until each blocker is independently cleared.
